message:
Now I understand the vulnerability. The issue is at line 7411: `bp = (b_info *)(void *)&peek_arr[boff];` where `boff` is found by `find_le32(peek_arr, sizeof(peek_arr), size)`. If `boff` is close to the end of `peek_arr` (e.g., `boff` = N_PEEK - 1 or N_PEEK - 2), then reading `bp->sz_unc`, `bp->sz_cpr`, `bp->b_method`, `bp->b_ftid`, `bp->b_cto8` (which is `sizeof(b_info)` = 12 bytes) will read past the end of the 64-byte `peek_arr` buffer, causing a stack-buffer-overflow.

Let me look at `find_le32` and the `b_info` structure:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "find_le32" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/ | head -20 && echo "---" && grep -n "struct b_info" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/*.h /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/src/*.cpp 2>/dev/null | head</｜｜DSML｜｜>
